Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study primarily focuses on a high-throughput method (HTPS) to profile protease specificity. The specific proteomics dataset described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'Allosteric effects' section focuses on the differential effect of Na+ (via NaCl) compared to other monovalent cations (ChCl, LiCl) on the activity and specificity of blood coagulation proteases. The general protease screen (Trypsin, etc.) is a benchmarking exercise rather than a differential perturbation study.
